query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM room_members
                    WHERE room_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
                ) AS "is_member!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM room_member_kick_cooldowns
                    WHERE room_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
                      AND ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                ) AS "is_in_kick_cooldown!"
